summary: Completed testing of HUNTIQ V3 BIONIC™ Territory Page with MapLibre GL. Fixed critical map rendering issue (height: 0px). All 12 backend API tests pass (100%). Frontend Territory page fully functional with map interaction, waypoint creation, territory scoring, and real-time weather data from OpenWeatherMap.

minor.issue: Quebec government WMS servers block CORS requests from browser - layers cannot be loaded directly in frontend
minor.note: This is an external service limitation, not a code bug. Would require backend proxy to resolve.

passed_tests: ✅ /api/geospatial/weather/current returns valid data structure (location, temperature, humidity, condition)
✅ /api/geospatial/weather/current includes hunting score (0-100) with level and recommendation
✅ /api/geospatial/potential/calculate returns component scores (terrain, water, forest, geology, vegetation)
✅ /api/geospatial/potential/components returns 7 components with weights summing to 1.0
✅ /api/geospatial/potential/calculate correctly validates center_point field (422 when missing)
✅ Frontend Territory page loads with MapLibre GL map
✅ Map renders Quebec region with Carto Dark tiles
✅ Map click selects location and displays coordinates
✅ Waypoint creation form works (name, type selection)
✅ Waypoints are added to list with delete functionality
✅ Score tab displays territory score (53/100 moderate)
✅ Weather panel shows real-time data (-5°C, hunting score 65/100 'bon')
✅ Equipment recommendations displayed based on waypoints and score
action_items: OPTIONAL: Implement backend proxy for WMS layers to bypass CORS restrictions from Quebec government servers
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Map container had height: 0px due to missing explicit height/width styles on inner div. Added 'w-full h-full' classes and inline styles.
OpenWeatherMap integration is REAL - using API key from backend/.env
WMS layers (LiDAR, Hydro, Forest) are blocked by CORS - external service limitation
seed_data_creation: None - using real OpenWeatherMap API and Quebec government WMS services
context_for_next_testing_agent: Territory page is fully functional. Map uses MapLibre GL with Carto Dark tiles (open-source). Weather data comes from OpenWeatherMap API (real data). WMS layers from Quebec government are blocked by CORS in browser - this is expected behavior for external government services.
